name: Munger AI - Proactive Outreach

options.systemMessage:
PASTE THE FULL CONTENTS OF config/system_prompt.txt HERE.

Additional instruction for outreach messages: You are initiating contact, not responding to a question. Be concise, punchy, and worth interrupting someone's day for. You are texting, not giving a speech. Maximum 4-5 sentences unless the topic genuinely demands more.

parameters.name: search_munger_writings
parameters.description: Search Charlie Munger's writings and speeches to find relevant quotes and ideas that apply to the current topic or news. Use this to make sure outreach messages are grounded in actual Munger thinking.

notes: Set REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID to your personal Telegram chat ID (get it by messaging @userinfobot on Telegram). Two triggers: 1) Morning wisdom at 7:30 AM daily, 2) News scan every 4 hours on weekdays. Only fires on news scan if significant keywords are found. Replace RSS URLs with feeds that work for you - WSJ and Bloomberg may require subscriptions.
